modules.module: Immutable source-located specification, key encodings, rows, candidate/sample identities, observations, errors, cancellation and SPI value types.
Typed immutable configuration, validation, effective configuration origins, legacy properties import and capability report.
XLSX, JSON, YAML, TOML and Java builder readers/writers with identical normalized ScenarioSpec; no persistence side effects.
Lazy exact rank/unrank combinatorial operators, cardinality, deterministic splitting, byte row operations.
FW directive parser, verb AST, brace/group lowering, virtual sheets, dependency DAG, census, cost and capability validation.
Run-scoped dictionary/table catalog, chunked byte blocks, cursors, memory leases, budgeted materialization; no SQL engine.
Typed rule evaluator, baseline/absence state, bonds, SAT-like backtracking where needed, deterministic t-wise selection and feasibility.
Stage evaluation, mandatory/optional assembly, source rendering, ranked candidate cursor and bounded production.
JDK JavaCompiler in-memory source/bytecode, bounded digest cache, diagnostics and isolated run-owned classloaders; no command-line javac.
Immutable idempotent sample repository, attempt selection, repeat projections, attachment retention and exact counters.
Typed SUT plugin SPI, cooperative deadlines, repeat/retry workers, outcome classification and bounded output capture.
Metrics, weighted aggregations, coverage, sampling, ranking, repeat uncertainty, numerical optimization, Pareto and multiobjective algorithms.
RunService facade, lifecycle, backpressure, deterministic windows, iterations, elites/mutation, provenance and checkpoint coordination.
Optional XML/JSON/CSV reports, checksummed snapshot codecs and legacy import/export; no mandatory disk transport.
Pure Java ports of deterministic SUT/oracle fixtures; no production framework depends on this test fixture module.
Java Swing scenario editor, graph/table views, metrics/progress, pause/cancel, results and optimization visualizers.
CLI and single runnable distribution, headless mode, embedded facade wiring and shutdown lifecycle.
Cross-module golden/differential/property/lifecycle/resource tests and architecture dependency gates; test-only artifact.
modules.packaging: Root pom packaging=pom; runtime distribution includes all production modules and pure-Java dependencies. Merge ServiceLoader descriptors. Public command: java -jar fw-app.jar run --config runtime.properties --scenario scenario.json. desktop and validate/plan/analyze/resume/export/capabilities are sibling commands. Exact CLI syntax is frozen at M00.
modules.guard: Do not depend on source checkout artifacts. Avoid com.company package collisions. Acceptance dependencies are test scope. Test fixture modules never enter the application distribution by accident.
